words.chinese: （在餐廳等場所）記錄並接受顧客的點餐需求。

words.engDef: slightly sour in taste; also a small open pie
words.example: The hotel buffet offered a variety of desserts, including a delicious tart with a slightly tart lemon filling.
words.chinese: （食物）微酸的；（通常指水果或派）帶有酸味的

words.engDef: tries a small amount of food; also the flavours of things
words.example: The chef insists that all ingredients must taste fresh before being used in the dish.
words.chinese: 品嚐；嚐到（味道）
words.rootPrefix: taxare (to touch, to judge) -> to test it by touching

words.engDef: trying a small amount of food or drink to judge it
words.example: The restaurant offers a wine tasting event every Saturday.
words.chinese: 品嚐；試吃（通常指為了評估品質或風味）
words.rootPrefix: taxare (to touch, to judge) -> to test it by touching

words.engDef: a small spoon used for stirring, or its measure
words.example: Could you please add one teaspoon of sugar to my coffee?
words.chinese: 茶匙；一茶匙（容量約 5 毫升）

words.engDef: small sums given for good service; also useful pieces of advice
words.example: The restaurant staff relies on tips to supplement their income.
words.chinese: 小費；建議（通常指給服務人員的額外金錢）；提示（資訊或建議）

words.engDef: an item such as soap or toothpaste used for washing
words.example: Remember to pack your toiletries, like a toothbrush and toothpaste, for the trip.
words.chinese: 洗漱用品;盥洗用品

words.engDef: soft red fruit eaten as a vegetable
words.example: The restaurant offers a variety of salads featuring fresh tomatoes and greens.
words.chinese: 番茄；（多數情況下指）番茄類產品

words.engDef: a small pointed stick for removing food from the teeth
words.example: Could you please pass me a toothpick? I have something stuck in my teeth.
words.chinese: 牙籤；用於餐點的細小木棍

words.engDef: covered on the upper surface with something
words.example: The chef topped the salad with a balsamic vinaigrette.
words.chinese: 覆蓋在...之上；裝飾（食物）

words.engDef: cloths used for drying the body or dishes
words.example: The hotel provides complimentary towels and toiletries for all guests.
words.chinese: 毛巾；擦拭布，通常指飯店或旅館提供的。

words.engDef: a flat board with raised edges for carrying food
words.example: The waiter carefully balanced a tray of drinks to the guests.
words.chinese: 托盤；餐盤架

words.engDef: a large bird eaten especially at festive meals
words.example: The catering company is preparing a traditional Thanksgiving dinner featuring roasted turkey.
words.chinese: 火雞；（北美洲）感恩節
words.rootPrefix: Turkey (the country the bird was wrongly thought to come from)

words.engDef: a person who eats no animal products at all
words.example: The hotel offers a wide range of vegan options to cater to diverse dietary needs.
words.chinese: 完全素食者；不食用任何動物製品的人。

words.engDef: plants or parts of plants eaten as food
words.example: The hotel buffet offers a wide variety of fresh vegetables.
words.chinese: 蔬菜；植物性食物（通常指食用部分）
words.rootPrefix: vegere (to enliven) + -able -> the living, growing thing

words.engDef: an informal word for vegetables
words.example: Our restaurant prides itself on using fresh, locally sourced veggies in all our dishes.
words.chinese: 蔬菜（通常指新鮮、未加工的蔬菜）

words.engDef: crisp cakes baked in a patterned iron
words.example: The hotel offers a complimentary breakfast buffet including waffles, eggs, and pastries.
words.chinese: 一種由格子狀麵糊烤製成的早餐或甜點，通常搭配糖漿、水果或奶油。

words.engDef: to wait until a place in a restaurant is free
words.example: We're on a waiting list and will wait for a table to become available.
words.chinese: 等待座位，通常指在餐廳或咖啡廳等場所，因座位已滿而需要等待。

words.engDef: to serve food and drink to customers
words.example: The waiter will wait on you shortly.
words.chinese: 為...服務；（尤其指）在餐廳或商店裡為顧客提供服務；等候（某人）

words.engDef: the watery liquid left when milk turns to curds
words.example: Whey protein is a popular supplement among athletes and bodybuilders.
words.chinese: 乳清；乳漿

words.engDef: cream beaten until it is light and thick
words.example: The dessert menu features a decadent chocolate cake with fresh strawberries and a generous dollop of whipped cream.
words.chinese: 鮮奶油，通常指打發後的奶油，用於裝飾甜點或飲料。

words.engDef: a tool used to beat eggs or cream quickly
words.example: The chef used a whisk to quickly combine the eggs and sugar.
words.chinese: （廚房用具）打蛋器；快速混合（成分）

words.engDef: alcoholic drinks made from grapes
words.example: The restaurant offers a wide selection of wines from around the world.
words.chinese: 葡萄酒（複數）；多種葡萄酒的選擇。

words.engDef: a deep round pan used in Chinese cooking
words.example: The restaurant's signature dish is stir-fried noodles cooked in a traditional wok.
words.chinese: 炒鍋，一種用於中式烹飪的扁底深鍋，常用於快速翻炒食材。

words.engDef: a substance used to make bread rise and to brew beer
words.example: Yeast is an essential ingredient for making bread rise.
words.chinese: 酵母；酵母菌

words.engDef: very pleasant to eat
words.example: This cake is really yummy!
words.chinese: 美味的; 好吃的
